system.description:
Last Clansmen

You are the last of your clan, or branch family. You were the sole survivor of a major life-changing event. Maybe your village or city was attacked by some great evil, or maybe you were tricked by some greater power. No matter the details, everyone other than you died, and you survived. Where were you when it happened? What age? Were you a small child, or a young adult? What attacked you? Was it a sole assailant, or a group? What effect did this have on you? Were you traumatized, or were you strengthened by it? Did you run away, or did you fight it?

Skill Proficiencies: Perception, Survival

Tool Proficiencies: Cooking Kit

Equipment: A Trinket of your family, a set of fine clothes, a generic looking key to a lock your family once owned.

Equipment Pack: Explorer’s Pack or Crafters Pack (Choose one).

Feature: Lonely

Years of surviving alone have made you self-sufficient in ways others are not. You can perform all basic survival tasks automatically without a check in non-extreme environments. When conditions require a Survival check you make it with advantage. Your solitary travels have also sharpened your sense of direction and terrain awareness. You cannot become lost by mundane means and can retrace any path you have traveled before.

Lone Survivor

Gain a General or Skill feat from Chapter 13 (Recommended: Any Constitution based Skill Feat)
